Create or refresh the agent environment (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, permissions, adb shim)

Usage:
  adbuddy env init [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy env init
  adbuddy env init --force
  adbuddy env init --dir ~/ADBuddy/pixel --json

Flags:
      --dir string   environment directory (default: workspace in config.toml, else ~/ADBuddy/default)
      --force        rewrite AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the skills (NOTES.md is never touched; a skill file with <!-- adbuddy:user --> is kept)
  -h, --help         help for init

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout
